cohort: The study included 656 neonates admitted to the special care baby unit of Nnamdi Azikiwe University Teaching Hospital, Nigeria.
finding: The study observed a 22.9% mortality rate among admitted neonates, with perinatal asphyxia, preterm birth, congenital anomalies, and neonatal sepsis identified as primary causes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a variable statistically associated with the outcome of care.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively over a period of 2 years, from January 2021 to December 2022.
